title: xAI’s last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota’s anti-nudification app law
slides: Can xAI stop a law it didn't see coming?
Minnesota targets apps that undress people in photos.
xAI's model powers the very detection tools at risk.
Compliance may force removing key safety features statewide.
Watch which state votes next—your platform could be next.
thread_text:
1. A law no one expected

Minnesota just passed a bill banning apps that undress photos—and xAI’s model is the engine behind the detection tools.

2. The irony cuts deep

Grok powers the very software that flags nude fakes. If the ban holds, xAI must disable that feature statewide.

3. Compliance has a price

To follow the law, xAI may need to strip out key safety detection. That leaves users blind to deepfakes.

4. The ripple starts here

Other states are watching Minnesota’s vote. Illinois and New York have already introduced similar bills.

5. Your move

Check if your state has a bill like this pending. If not, email your representative today.
